/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 48-year-old man presents to the clinic feeling depressed after a string of failed business projects. His team noticed that he seems less engaged than he once used to be and this is reflecting in his work. He has no previous psychiatric history and symptoms of depressed mood have been ongoing for the past 6 months. A patient health questionnaire 9 (PHQ-9) was administered and the patient scored 10. The patient is started on venlafaxine. The alteration in the normal functioning of which of the following is the mechanism of action for this therapy?

Options:
A. Serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine
B. Norepinephrine and dopamine
C. Serotonin only
D. Serotonin receptor antagonism
E. Alpha-2 receptor antagonism

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question asks about the mechanism of action of venlafaxine, a psychiatric medication, which falls under psychopharmacology."}
